D.t: Val Hoyle leads by 19.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 67,554 votes; a one point swing is about 1,716 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +11.5 and D +28.4. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$521K cash against $388K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
